title: Lecturer in Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Theodore Tso is a lecturer in Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences in maxillofacial prosthetics. He received his undergraduate degree at the University of Southern California and then attended the University of Pennsylvania for his Doctorate in Dental Medicine (DMD). He next went to Harbor-UCLA Medical Center for an internship in general dentistry, completed specialty training in prosthodontics at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine, and a fellowship in maxillofacial prosthetics at the UCLA School of Dentistry & the David Geffen School of Medicine. Tso is a Diplomate of the American Board of Prosthodontics, Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists, and Associate Fellow of the American Academy of Maxillofacial Prosthetics. Tso’s research interests are in rehabilitation of non-conventional maxillofacial resections and on the oral side effects of radiotherapy.
